caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a wide mouth and slightly outward-flaring lip, shown in a three-quarter view. The jar is light brown with some darker brown shading to indicate its rounded shape and shadows. Two symmetrical, small, rounded handles are attached near the top on either side. On the front surface of the jar, there is a blue design featuring a stylized face with wings, suggesting a cherub or angel motif. Above the design, there is text that reads "1 1/2 POTTERY WORKS" accompanied by four stars and the abbreviations "LIV," "ST.," and "NY," all written in blue. The interior of the jar is shaded darker to indicate depth. The background of the drawing is an off-white or cream color, with no other objects present. The artist's signature is visible in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Jar
